title: A multiscale radiation biophysical stochastic model describing the cell survival response at ultra-high dose rate

coverage_blockers: No public Julia source from authors (verified search of fcordoni/Battestini/2MaBa/MS-GSM2); no raw experimental clonogenic data released (Adrian2020/Tessonnier2021/Tinganelli2022a); TRAX-CHEM microdosimetric specific-energy spectra not bundled; per-domain SSA with full per-domain chemistry simplified to cell-average chemistry; no published figure-vs-figure overlay yet
